changelog: Notes+ 16.4: text notes are edited as they look, like Word: bold, italic, headings, lists, tasks and colours, with no symbols on screen, stored as the same Markdown on Android, Windows and the web. Repairs notes damaged by the 16.1 test build. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 16.4 for Windows: notes edited as they look, like WordPad, with a format bar; italics fixed; stored as Markdown shared with your phone and the web.
